family_reports.body: If you are getting food stamps or cash aide, do not tell them the father’s name. Once they go after father he might try to avoid paying by aiming for 50/50 custody even though he could care less about parental before. Additionally, try to educate your child about the proper names of body parts so they can describe situations better. Try to get them to tell the full story when they tell the simple ones such as what time of day or exact time and location so it’s habit if really big situations come up. Recognize if there is any physical evidence or witnesses. Document all dates and times of problematic situations without sounding spiteful to a judge. My child was only 3.5 when she notified me of SA from her father. I didn’t think to teacher her these things at that young age. Learn from my mistake on that one and teach your kids boundaries and body parts names. Also, don’t trust anybody court appointed. That evaluator and therapist are not your friend.

The system has made me believe they will not help keep myself or my children safe from a predator. They would rather make money at the suffering of families all over the world as Destruction of the family unit is the number one goal.
